gatesū.g: corānaṁ āgamanaṁ ñatvā “paṭhamataraṁyeva gantvā saddaṁ karissāmā”ti corānaṁ abhimukhaṁ gatesu.
ettha agatesupi bhojanakicce niṭṭhite gaṇhituṁ vaṭṭati.
corānaṁ āgamanaṁ ñatvā “paṭhamataraññeva gantvā saddaṁ karissāmā”ti corānaṁ abhimukhaṁ gatesu, “corehi haṭabhaṇḍaṁ āharissāmā”ti tadanupathaṁ gatesupi eseva nayo.
ettha akappiyanimantanādhivāsanakkhaṇe pubbapayoge dukkaṭampi natthi, viññattito pasavane pana viññattikkhaṇe itarasikkhāpadehi dukkaṭaṁ hotīti gahetabbaṁ.

gatesu.l: Tesu gatesu vā agatesu vā purimanayeneva paṭipajjitabban
gatesu.g: ettha ūne gaṇe caraṇaṁ anuṭṭhahanaṁ ekarattampi gaṇena vippavāsaṁ, sace rattiyā ekakkhaṇena saṁgho vasati, sace so pure aruṇameva kenaci karaṇīyena gatoti etthapi mānattepi evaṁ jāte.

gate.g: yodhaṁ vijjhitvā pitari viddhe, yodhaṁ pana avijjhitvā kevalaṁ pitari viddhepi visaṅketo natthiyeva pitaripi vadhakacittassa atthitāya, kevalaṁ yodhe viddhepi eseva nayo.
Kassapagotta evaṁ tava citte pavatte sati pañhakālo na hoti.
api tu evaṁ gate kāle mayi imasmiṁ ṭhāne pāsena baddhe.
yo savisena sallena samappito idāneva maṁ paṭimanteti, so ajja evaṁ gate kāle evaṁ maraṇakāle sampatte kiñci appamattakampi na bhāsati.
nettari kuṭilaṁ gate sati, nettassa kuṭilaṁ gatattāti attho.

Gatena.g: pekkhitena palobhane Ummādantījātakaṁ1, dunnivatthena Niḷinikājātakaṁ2, mañjunā bhaṇitena “tuvaṭaṁ kho ayyaputta āgaccheyyāsī”ti Nandattherassa vatthu3 kathetabbaṁ.

Gateti.g: pubbe abhikkamapaṭikkamagahaṇena gamanepi purato, pacchato ca kāyassa atiharaṇaṁ vuttanti idha gamanameva gahitan”ti1 Ācariyānandattherena vuttaṁ, taṁ kecivādo nāma Ācariyadhammapālattherena kataṁ.
pubbe abhikkamapaṭikkamaggahaṇena gamanepi purato pacchato ca kāyassa atiharaṇaṁ vuttanti idha gamanameva gahitanti veditabbaṁ, vakkhamāno vā etesaṁ viseso.
